Unit 1 of 10: Le système éducatif après le bac

Key ideas

  • Le baccalauréat (le bac) ends the lycée (terminale). Since the 2021 reform, the bac général has a common core plus spécialités (two in terminale), a written philosophy exam and a grand oral. There are also the bac technologique and the bac professionnel.
  • Parcoursup — the national online platform for applying to higher education.
  • After the bac: l'université (licence, master, doctorat — the LMD system: 3 + 2 + 3 years), les classes préparatoires (prépas, 2 years) for les grandes écoles, le BTS / le BUT (short technical courses), les écoles spécialisées (art, commerce, journalism).
  • Une mention = distinction: assez bien, bien, très bien.

Worked examples

Example 1: What is Parcoursup? Answer: the national online platform for applying to higher education after the bac.

Example 2: How many years is a licence? Answer: three years.

10-mark practice set

  1. (1 mark) What does LMD stand for? Answer: Licence, Master, Doctorat.
  2. (1 mark) What is the highest mention at the bac? Answer: très bien.
  3. (2 marks) Name two types of bac. Answer: any two: général, technologique, professionnel (1 each).
  4. (3 marks) True or false: (a) Prépas last four years. (b) A master takes two years after a licence. (c) Grandes écoles often recruit after prépas. Answer: (a) false — two years (1); (b) true (1); (c) true (1).
  5. (3 marks) Write three sentences in French about what you want to do after Class 12. Answer: e.g. Après le bac, je voudrais aller à l'université (1). Je vais étudier l'informatique (1). Ensuite, je ferai un master (1).

Common mistakes

  1. Le bac thought to be a university degree.
  2. Mixing up licence (degree) and permis (licence to drive).
  3. Prépa length.
  4. Mention translated as "mention".
  5. Parcoursup confused with an exam.

Quick recall

  1. Final lycée year? 2. Oral exam of the bac? 3. Short technical diploma? 4. Doctorate length? 5. Application platform?

Answers: 1) Terminale. 2) Le grand oral. 3) BTS / BUT. 4) About three years. 5) Parcoursup.
